$comment: The CROOKS BUILDER development environment, as data. This file is the source of truth for
scripts/dev_env.py (doctor and bootstrap). Nothing here is installed on the production
server or by the CROOKS service; this is tooling for an engineering worktree only.
Every entry is PINNED. Nothing self-updates. The update policy is:
upstream update -> security scan -> diff -> test -> review -> update this manifest.

notes.system_packages: none — /usr is read-only in the watcher sandbox and is never modified
notes.network_listeners: none — no tool here opens a listening socket
notes.secrets: none — no tool here requires an API key. SkillSpector runs --no-llm.

environment.$comment: Exported by `eval "$(python3 scripts/dev_env.py env)"`. Required for Chromium and for CROOKS's own scripts/browser/*.js to resolve playwright.

binaries.$comment: Single static binaries, fetched from upstream GitHub releases into .tooling/bin.

shellcheck.purpose: shell static analysis; CROOKS ships shell in mac/ and launchd/

shfmt.purpose: shell formatting — CHECK ONLY (-d), never -w on existing CROOKS shell

gitleaks.purpose: secret scanning before any commit or publication
gitleaks.trigger: explicit, and recommended as a pre-publication gate
gitleaks.policy: findings are reported by RULE and PATH only. A secret value is never printed, echoed or committed.

ast-grep.purpose: structural (AST) search and refactoring across Python and JS
ast-grep.policy: upstream also ships an `sg` alias. It is DELETED on install: /usr/bin/sg is newgrp, and shadowing it from a PATH prepend is a real hazard. Use `ast-grep`.

hyperfine.purpose: command benchmarking with warmup and statistics; used for the pytest-xdist work

trivy.network: downloads a vulnerability DB on first use

uv.purpose: fast Python installer; provides the isolated tool env for SkillSpector

node.$comment: npm project at .tooling/node. Exact versions; PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 at install, browsers fetched separately into .tooling/browsers.

playwright.purpose: browser automation. NOT NEW to CROOKS — crooks-assistant/scripts/browser/*.js already require('playwright'/'playwright-core'). This pin REVIVES the existing 11-script harness, which was inert on this server.
playwright.pin_ration: 1.56.1 ships Chromium build 1194, which is exactly the build experience/browser.py already expects at chromium-1194. The pin was chosen to match existing CROOKS source, not the newest release.

@axe-core/playwright.purpose: WCAG/ARIA automated auditing inside a Playwright page
@axe-core/playwright.policy: supplements the CROOKS collision and touch harnesses; does not replace them. axe cannot see two boxes that are each the right size and in the same place.

@biomejs/biome.policy: ADVISORY / CHECK-ONLY. Never `biome format --write` and never `biome check --apply` over web/. A baseline has NOT been established; this is not a gate.

$comment: Chromium needs 12 shared libraries that are not present on this host. `apt-get install`
cannot be used: /usr is READ-ONLY in the watcher sandbox, by design, and must stay that way.
So the .deb payloads are extracted into a builder-local prefix and reached with
LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Nothing outside /opt/crooks-builder is written, and the sandbox is not
weakened. libc6/libgcc-s1/libstdc++6/gcc-14-base are deliberately EXCLUDED so the system

owner_approved_alternative.$comment: If the owner prefers a real system install instead of the local sysroot, this is the exact command. It requires a writable /usr and is NOT run by bootstrap.
owner_approved_alternative.command: apt-get install -y libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0t64 libatk-bridge2.0-0t64 libcups2t64 libatspi2.0-0t64 libxdamage1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libasound2t64
owner_approved_alternative.status: NOT RUN — needs owner approval and a writable /usr

python.$comment: venv at crooks-assistant/.venv, created by `make venv` (pip install -e '.[dev]'), plus builder-only test tooling. The builder had NO venv before this round; the browser and experience suites could not run here at all.

pytest-xdist.policy: ADOPT ONLY on evidence of determinism across repeated runs. Not enabled by default.

hypothesis.policy: apply only where property testing genuinely helps — parsers, serialization, the proposal/action state machine, future Event Ledger logic. Do NOT rewrite existing tests to claim usage.

pyright.policy: ADVISORY / CHECK-ONLY. No baseline established; not a gate.

python.policy: NO retry plugin. A flaky test is never hidden behind a rerun.

skillspector.purpose: security gate for third-party Agent Skills — the required scan before any skill is installed
skillspector.network: api.osv.dev for the SC4 supply-chain check; falls back to a bundled list offline. Sends dependency COORDINATES only, never file contents.
skillspector.policy: --no-llm is MANDATORY here. It keeps file contents local and needs no API key. No API key is provisioned for this tool.
